newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares maintain record-smashing bull run.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares maintain record-smashing bull run.

text.p: Estonian shares kept on climbing on Friday, pushing the record-smashing market to fresh highs in active trade.
Trade was 104 million kroons and the index rose 3.51 percent to hit a new record of 334.18. It added 9.41 percent this week.

Dealers cautioned that a spell of profit-taking might hit the market next week but better than expected interim results and upcoming profit revision forecasts in key banking stocks should keep the momentum rolling upward.
"Strong buying pressure, which has kept stocks surging, has postponed it (profit-taking) so far," one dealer said.
Dealers also said that foreign interest was strong, possibly prompted by Estonia's inclusion this week in the first wave of EU expansion talks.
Hoiupank gained five percent or 9.30 kroons to close at 194.30 kroons. Hoiupank was the biggest winner during the week, adding 12.6 percent.
Hansapank rose four percent or 7.50 kroons to 191.00 kroons. Uhispank was the most active with 40 million kroons traded and it gained 1.95 kroons to 57 kroons.
On the free market, Norma traded seven million kroons to gain 1.95 kroons to 86.25 kroons.
Rakvere meat factory was also active in trade of 2.9 million kroons to 14.55 kroons.
